enforcement_levels.program: Enforced by the Solana program: an invalid transaction fails on-chain.
enforcement_levels.framework: Enforced by the reference engine in this framework; next candidate for the program.
enforcement_levels.advisory: Raised as an alert for human review; not a legal violation by itself.
enforcement_levels.human: A legal judgment that stays human; the protocol records who decided and the evidence hash.

rules.title: Per-adherent cap: 50% of the registered quantity, rounded down
rules.rule: A non-participating body may adhere to at most 50% of the quantity registered for the item. Fractions are rounded down.
sources: Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 32, I; Decreto AL 95.019/2023, art. 32, I
TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, item 9.1.1.6 (round down) and para. 67 (the federal system rounded up)
rules.practice: A state central purchasing body computes 50% of 21 units as 10, 'observada a impossibilidade de fracionamento' (founder field observation).

rules.title: Global cap: twice the registered quantity, or the lower tender maximum
rules.rule: All adhesions to an item together may not exceed twice its registered quantity, nor the maximum for non-participants set in the tender; zero forbids adhesions.
sources: TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, para. 66 (federal system showed balances of -2, -155 and -25)
rules.practice: The federal Gestão de Atas formula: balance for adhesions = maximum - (awaiting authorization + authorized).

rules.title: Reserve at request; refuse when nothing is available
rules.rule: A request reserves quantity immediately; no request or authorization may proceed when the available balance is zero or negative.
sources: Guia Prático Gestão de Ata SRP/SIASGNet (balance formula)
rules.practice: State central purchasing body practice: authorization reserves the balance; after use, 'baixa definitiva do saldo' or 'restituição do saldo correspondente' (founder field observation).

rules.title: Supplier acceptance precedes authorization
rules.rule: The managing body authorizes only after the supplier has accepted the adhesion.
rules.practice: In the field, acceptance arrives by e-mail and is attached as a PDF to the process and to Compras.gov.br ('Anexo Aceitação'). Solutio records it as the supplier's signature.

rules.title: No authorization after the record expires
rules.rule: Requests and authorizations are refused outside the validity of the price record, even when the request was filed while it was valid.

rules.title: Execute within 90 days; extension within validity; lapse releases quantity
rules.rule: After authorization the adherent must contract within 90 days; the manager may extend within validity; after the deadline anyone may lapse the adhesion and its quantity returns to the balance.
sources: TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, items 9.1.1.9 and 9.1.1.10 (deadline tracked by hand)
rules.practice: Authorization despachos remind the adherent of the 90-day limit in free text.

rules.title: Roles are fixed: manager, participant, adherent
rules.rule: The manager does not adhere to its own record; a participant is not recorded as an adherent nor vice versa.

rules.title: Federal bodies do not adhere to non-federal records
rules.rule: Federal bodies may not adhere to records managed by state, district or municipal bodies.

rules.title: Alagoas: state bodies adhere to municipal records only of state capitals
rules.rule: State bodies may not adhere to records managed by municipal bodies, except those managed by municipalities that are state capitals and by the Federal District.

rules.title: Exceptions lift the global cap only when they apply, never the per-adherent cap
rules.rule: Emergency health purchases under Ministry of Health records, and subnational adhesions required for voluntary transfers of a federal programme under federal records, are exempt from the 2x cap; the 50% cap still applies.

rules.title: Participants draw only from their own registered quota
rules.rule: A participating body uses only the quantity registered for it on that item; a body that is not a participant of the record cannot use it as a participant.
rules.practice: Supply authorizations are issued per record 'ao órgão participante, tendo em vista que existe saldo de demanda'; items of a record where the body is not a participant are refused (founder field observation).

rules.title: Rectifying an authorization restores the balance
rules.rule: When an authorization is rectified downward or not used, the difference returns to the available balance; it never increases the registered quantity.
rules.practice: Authorizations are re-issued as 'RETIFICAÇÃO' after budget review (founder field observation).

rules.title: Every adhesion goes through the system of record
rules.rule: Adhesion requests made outside the system of record are not accepted.
rules.practice: The same adhesion is recorded in the electronic process, in Compras.gov.br and in an internal control system or spreadsheet (founder field observation).
rules.code: by construction: a quantity can only be reserved by a program instruction

rules.title: Registered, contracted and remaining quantities are public per item
rules.rule: Managing bodies publish registered quantities, contracts made and balances per item.

rules.title: Object-level aggregation alert
rules.rule: When one body adheres to several items of the same object, report its share of the object's total registered quantity.
sources: Open question: art. 86 §4 is written per item
rules.practice: A body needing 18 units, capped at 10 on one item, reached 18 by adhering to three items with the same description and price (founder field observation).

rules.title: Framework agreements state a maximum and are exhausted when it is reached
rules.rule: The notice states the maximum quantity or value; once reached, the framework agreement has no further effect.
sources: CJEU C-23/20 Simonsen & Weel (2021), operative part 1 and paras. 54, 67-68

rules.title: Only authorities identified in the notice may call off
rules.rule: Call-offs are limited to contracting authorities clearly identified in the call for competition.

rules.title: Optional per-authority split of the maximum
rules.rule: The maximum may be divided among the participating authorities, each with its own figure.

rules.title: Liquidation before payment or financing
rules.rule: A debt exists for the protocol only after liquidation (origin, amount and creditor verified) signed by the debtor body.

rules.title: Chronological payment order per funding source and category
rules.rule: Payments follow the order in which claims became payable, per funding source and category (goods, leases, services, works); a deviation needs a prior justification in a listed case and is published.

rules.title: Two months of delay lets the supplier suspend
rules.rule: A payment delay of more than two months from the invoice entitles the supplier to suspend performance or terminate.

rules.title: One receivable, one cumulative financing limit
rules.rule: The total financed against a receivable never exceeds its eligible amount; a fiscal document backs only one receivable.
sources: Design rule; analogous to the uniqueness guarantee of registered card receivables (Resolução CMN 4.734/2019) and electronic duplicatas (Lei 13.775/2018)
Failure cases: Qingdao duplicate warehouse receipts (conviction, 2018); First Brands and Tricolor (2025, alleged)

rules.title: Assignment requires notice to the debtor
rules.rule: Financing requires the creditor's signature and evidence that the debtor was notified.

rules.title: AntecipaGov profile: 70% of the remaining balance, follow-ons with the same bank
rules.rule: Advances against a federal contract are limited to 70% of what remains to be paid; a second operation on the same contract must be with the same bank; the body pays into the linked account.

rules.title: Public authorities pay within 30 days (60 for public health)
rules.rule: Payment terms of public authorities may not exceed 30 days from the invoice, or 60 for public healthcare entities.
